# HOOPS24

> Free daily NBA trivia minigames: wordle, grids, guess-the-player and more. Play solo or online, score points and climb the leaderboard.

Server-rendered pages; each game has its own public URL.

## Games

- [Guess the Series Winner](https://nba-minigames.vercel.app/series-winner): pick the winner of a real NBA playoff series
- [Name the NBA Club](https://nba-minigames.vercel.app/name-logo): identify the franchise behind each logo
- [Guess the MVP](https://nba-minigames.vercel.app/guess-mvps): name the MVP for each season shown
- [Fill in the Starting 5](https://nba-minigames.vercel.app/starting-five): recall the starting lineup of a real game's winning team
- [NBA Wordle](https://nba-minigames.vercel.app/wordle): daily Wordle-style puzzle for an NBA player's last name
- [Fan Favorites](https://nba-minigames.vercel.app/fan-favorites): find the top answers 100 NBA fans gave to a survey question
- [Career Path Challenge](https://nba-minigames.vercel.app/career-path): name a player from his career stints, revealed team by team
- [Who Are Ya?](https://nba-minigames.vercel.app/who-are-ya): find the mystery player from attribute hints and a blurred photo
- [NBA Tic-Tac-Toe](https://nba-minigames.vercel.app/tictactoe): tic-tac-toe duel where each cell is a row + column criteria pair
- [LeContexto](https://nba-minigames.vercel.app/contexto): guess the secret player using a similarity rank

## Accounts, leaderboard and multiplayer

- [Home](https://nba-minigames.vercel.app/): game list, plus sign-up and log-in; an account keeps your points and rank and puts you on the leaderboard
- [Home](https://nba-minigames.vercel.app/): every game page has a Multiplayer panel (random 1v1 or a private friend room, login required); NBA Tic-Tac-Toe is the turn-based head-to-head duel

Last reviewed: 2026-09-30
